extracted.intended_audience: FDA/CFSAN staff; Health Hazard Evaluation Board; technical information specialists and risk reviewers
extracted.subtask_description: Internal FDA/CFSAN memoranda that compile and summarize consumer complaints of adverse reactions attributed to aspartame, including inclusion rules, demographic breakdowns, product-type attribution, symptom coding, severity classification, and data-management conventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion/exclusion of early-1980s complaints
rubrics_metrics.description: Six hundred and forty-nine of the complaints that were received in the early 1980's have differences in the adverse reaction information collected as compared to the remaining reports. Because of these differences, the 649 complaints are generally not included in the summaries of adverse reactions attributed to aspartame.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exclude the 649 early-1980s reports from summary tallies because their data collection differs from later reports; note exclusions explicitly when reporting totals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time window for the summary
rubrics_metrics.description: Summaries report complaints received 'from 1980 through 1994' (1995 memo) or 'from 1980 through 1996' (1997 memo), with totals presented for the specified period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify the exact years covered when giving totals; use the year-by-year receipt (e.g., ARMS entry year) to allocate reports to time periods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sources of reports included
rubrics_metrics.description: Complaints were either reported directly to CFSAN, or received from the Nutrasweet (Searle) Company, Aspartame Consumer Safety Network, 700 Club, health professionals, and other interested parties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attribute report counts by source when possible; include reports irrespective of source but document provenance in summaries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use only respondents who provided demographic fields for demographic percentages
rubrics_metrics.description: For the 4826 (73.3%) / 4949 (74.9%) complainants who provided information on gender, percentages are calculated only among those who provided that information. Similarly, age percentages are calculated among complainants whose ages were provided (e.g., 3271 (49.7%) / 3343 (50.6%)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When reporting gender- or age-distributions, compute percentages using the subset of complaints that included those fields; explicitly report the denominator (number and percent) that provided the field.

rubrics_metrics.name: Classification of intensity/severity
rubrics_metrics.description: Reports that included information on intensity of the reaction were classified as 'severe' or 'mild to moderate' (e.g., 518 (10.6%) severe and 436 (89.4%) mild-to-moderate in one memo; 537 (10.7%) severe and 4477 (89.3%) mild-to-moderate in the later memo).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Classify reported reactions into severity categories and report counts and percentages; indicate the number of reports that included intensity information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Product type attribution and multiple-product attribution
rubrics_metrics.description: In some reports adverse reactions were attributed to more than one product type. Diet soft drinks were implicated most frequently (e.g., 3021 (48.9%) / 3077 (46.6%)), followed by table-top sweeteners (e.g., 1716 (26.1%) / 1764 (26.7%)). Each remaining product type was mentioned in less than 10% of complaints.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Count and report product-type attributions, allow multiple product types per complaint, and present both counts and percent of total complaints mentioning each product type.

rubrics_metrics.name: Symptom enumeration and coding (multiple symptoms per complainant allowed)
rubrics_metrics.description: More than one symptom associated with aspartame was described by many complainants. Ninety / ninety-one different symptoms were described in total; many complainants described multiple symptoms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Code and enumerate distinct symptom terms across reports; allow each complainant to contribute multiple symptom counts; present total distinct symptom types and frequencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Presentation threshold for symptom tables
rubrics_metrics.description: Symptoms reported by large numbers of complainants are tabulated (e.g., symptoms reported by >100 complainants are shown in a table with counts and percent of reports).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When preparing summary tables, present symptoms that meet a chosen frequency threshold (the memos show those reported by 100+ complainants), with counts and percent of total reports; annotate that many other less-frequent symptoms exist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identification of most frequent symptoms
rubrics_metrics.description: The memos identify the most frequently reported symptoms (headache was most frequent, followed by dizziness/ problems with balance, change in vision, tinnitus, etc.) with specific counts and percentages (e.g., headache: 1847 (28.1%) / 1900 (28.7%)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlight and report the top-ranked symptoms by frequency (include counts and percent of total reports); ensure symptom labels are consistent across reporting periods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exposure pattern reporting (single vs multiple aspartame-containing products)
rubrics_metrics.description: Reports indicate whether the complainant consumed a single aspartame-containing product or more than one (e.g., a majority reported consumption of a single product; other reports implicated 2 or more products).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Capture and report number of aspartame-containing products consumed per complainant (single vs multiple) and present counts/percentages; note if inability to determine exposure for some reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data management and year-of-receipt tracking (ARMS)
rubrics_metrics.description: Reports are entered into the ARMS system; summaries may allocate reports by the year they were entered/received to analyze trends over time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the ARMS database for systematic entry and retrieval; when summarizing trends, allocate complaints to the year they were received/entered and document database provenance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting of denominators and caveats about totals
rubrics_metrics.description: The memos present total counts and explicitly indicate caveats such as exclusions and that 'THE ABOVE TOTAL MAY NOT REFLECT THE FINAL CHARGES FOR THIS REQUEST' (FOIA charge language appears in letter header) and other notes about completeness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Always report totals with clear denominators and state caveats (e.g., excluded reports, incomplete fields, or evolving counts) so readers understand limitations of the summarized data.
